events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, originally took place from August 15 to 18, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Woodstock Festival, a defining moment that brought together half a million people for three days of peace, love, and music back in '69. A true cultural landmark.

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Remembered
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who died on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us far too soon. His legacy, however, continues to shake, rattle, and roll.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Passing Remembered
events.blurb: The hip-hop community remembers the tragic shooting of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, a voice that defined a generation and whose words still resonate today. A true hip-hop icon.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Remembered
events.blurb: The music world commemorates the passing of the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we remember the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, a true guitar innovator whose electrifying sound changed music forever. Still as mind-blowing as ever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album, featuring that unforgettable zebra crossing cover, on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is one of the most famous in history, but the music inside is even better. A masterpiece.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday, having been born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' legend, still rocking with that unmistakable voice and attitude. Here's to a true original.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday, born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity. Truly iconic.

events.title: Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music, back in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple introduced the world to the original iPod. Remember carrying your entire music library in your pocket for the first time? A game changer.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating the enduring legacy of 007, from the iconic gadgets to those unforgettable theme tunes. A true British institution.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The music world remembers John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, having been born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. Imagine that.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday, born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his wit and brilliance are timeless. Still making us laugh.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse, and utterly brilliant double LP that proved they could do anything. A true landmark.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Remembered
events.blurb: The music world commemorates the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Freddie Mercury. A showman, a vocalist, a legend whose incredible talent continues to shine brightly. The show must go on.
